notes.title: Update Note 1
notes.content:
Greetings survivors, thank you all for your support! We are happy to share changes recently made to improve your game experience and fix bugs:

[b][h1]Patch note[/h1][/b]
1. Achievement "Meet and Greet" is now obtainable even if you didn't get it for unlocking Jesse last. Just visit any mission's character select screen and you have it!
2. Bug - Starting a new game after finishing the first level caused the spawning point to be placed in an unintended place
3. Bug - Missions with an ambush were having the progress bar stuck if the extraction circle was entered before the info message popped up

notes.title: Time has come!
notes.content: [p]Dive into the apocalypse with [b]Bullets & Brains[/b], the electrifying top-down 3D shooter hitting Steam on [b]June 26, 2025, at 10 AM GMT+2[/b]! Blast through zombie hordes in vibrant, chaotic arenas, solo or with friends in thrilling co-op mode. Choose your survivor, wield unique weapons, and collect brains to unleash devastating attacks. With stylized visuals and smooth controls, survival’s never been this fun! Ready to dominate the undead? [b][u]Wishlist Bullets & Brains now[/u][/b] and grab it on release to be the first to dive into the zombie-slaying frenzy! Enjoy a 15% discount on release and inform your friends about it, fighting zombies together is always better![/p]

notes.title: A huge thank you! We had a blast during Steam Next Fest.
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Steam Next Fest has come to an end, and we just want to say [b]a huge thank you[/b] to everyone who played the Bullets & Brains demo and left [b]such amazing reviews![/b] Your support means the world to us, and we’re grateful for every comment and suggestion. We’re working hard to make this game the best it can be, and your feedback is a big part of that.

Even though Next Fest is over, [i]we’re not done yet![/i] [b]The demo is still available for you to download and play[/b], so feel free to jump in anytime. [b]Don’t forget to wishlist[/b] the full game so you’re the first to know when it’s ready! And of course, keep the feedback coming—we love hearing from you!

Thanks again for all your support! We can't wait to share the full game with you!

With gratitude,
The Bullets & Brains Team

Play the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2617950/Bullets__Brains_Demo/

notes.title: Bullets & Brains Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the demo for Bullets & Brains is now live! Get ready to dive into this action-packed, top-down 3D shooter where you’ll face hordes of brain-hungry zombies in an epic post-apocalyptic world. Grab your weapon, choose your survivor, and get a taste of the chaos today!

[b]In the Demo, You’ll Be Able To:[/b]

[list][*] Choose between two distinctive characters, each with their own starting weapon. (More characters await you in the full game!)
[*] Explore a dangerous, sprawling post-apocalyptic environment filled with atmospheric locations and hidden secrets.
[*] Engage in intense combat against relentless waves of undead.
[*] Collect brains to level up and energy to unleash powerful, devastating abilities.[/list]

If you’re up for the challenge, don't forget that Bullets & Brains offers a co-op mode for even more mayhem with friends!

[b]Wishlist the full game now[/b] to stay updated and prepare for the ultimate zombie-slaying experience! Get ready for heart-pounding action, strategic combat, and endless waves of undead! [b]Play the demo today and let the fun begin![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - New abilities, map screen and customization items!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,
Welcome in our 1st devlog dedicated to the upcoming Bullets & Brains! 

We are extremely happy to share with you some updates that we are constantly working on - let's hope that these changes will make you even more excited for our game than ever before. 

[h2]New abilities[/h2]
First of all, we added new powerups that will make your gameplay more diverse and full of exposions! Let's take a quick look at it below! 

[previewyoutube=OovIhFMJMNM;full][/previewyoutube]

Is there a better way of fighting with hordes of zombies than using bombs, molotovs and spikes? Don't worry if you become a bit overwhelmed though! Healcircle comes to the rescue! 

[h2]Reworked map screen[/h2]
This time we focused on the map screen as well and the results present as it follows: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449681/51b50bd68991a8871bed6febf1ac6d7489c813a6.png[/img]

[h2]Customization items[/h2]
Let's not forget about the looks! We've added a bunch of customization items! 
Do you have any favourites so far? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449681/7777686bdc9bd55cc1a89e5e34bec97c272f16ba.png[/img]

Thank you for your attention - it means a lot! 
See you next time!

notes.title: Introducing Bullets & Brains
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44449681/730a28beaf820fead6c3c71a9d46c5ed34fb7570.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome to [b]Bullets & Brains[/b]! 
We are [b]Ajvar Studio[/b], a two-man team who has been working on this adrenaline-pumping arcade top-down 3D shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world! 

We are really happy to be a part of [b]Steam SHMUP FEST[/b] as well and we are even more excited for what the future will bring - and let us tell you, it’s gonna be fun! 

In the meantime, be sure to add Bullets & Brains to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b] to stay updated on the latest news and developments!
